description: This file contains a PHP function related to Twig, a templating engine. It provides a deprecated wrapper function to create a TemplateWrapper object from a string template, utilizing Twig's StringLoaderExtension. The file appears to be part of a larger project related to the Twig library, specifically the string_loader.php resource.

methods.name: twig_template_from_string
methods.description: A deprecated function that creates a TemplateWrapper from a string template within a Twig environment, wrapping the StringLoaderExtension::templateFromString method. It triggers a deprecation warning indicating it's internal and outdated since Twig 3.9.
